description: Epic agent-agnostic, member 3 of 6. Add a deterministic canonical->per-agent adapter build step to feature-forge: one generator (scripts/build-adapters.py) that walks the spec-pure canon (11 skills, 3 sub-agents, the references/ trees) and emits a self-contained, provenance-stamped adapters/<agent>/ tree for claude/codex/copilot/cursor/gemini, plus a hand-authored AGENTS.md and a regenerate-and-diff drift guard wired into scripts/validate.sh. items.title: Implement discovery and parse stages in build-adapters.py
items.description:
Extend scripts/build-adapters.py with the discovery (stage 1) and parse (stage 2) procedures from spec 02 §1 and §3. Implement exactly as written there.

1. Discovery (02 §1): SKILLS_GLOB = "skills/*/SKILL.md", AGENTS_GLOB = "agents/*.md", REFERENCES_ROOT = "references"; discover_skill_paths(root) and discover_agent_paths(root) returning paths SORTED by repo-relative POSIX path (byte order, never OS glob order).
2. Parse (02 §3, contract in 00 §3): read_canon_text(path, source_path) reads UTF-8 and normalizes CRLF/CR to \n, raising UnreadableFileError on failure; split_frontmatter(text, source_path) splits on the first/next column-0 `---`, safe_load-s the block (must be a mapping), raising MalformedFrontmatterError on any malformed/unbalanced/invalid-YAML/non-mapping case; parse_skill(path, root) builds a SkillRecord (require string name == directory name else MissingNameError; description must be str; metadata must be mapping or None; own_refs = skills/<name>/references/ if it is a dir else None); parse_agent(path, root) builds an AgentRecord (name == file stem else MissingNameError; claude_keys = frontmatter minus name/description, preserving source/document order).

Fail fast on any unprocessable canon (REQ-ROB-01) — raise the correct CanonError subclass, never crash, never silently skip.
acceptanceCriteria: discover_skill_paths/discover_agent_paths use globs skills/*/SKILL.md and agents/*.md and return lists sorted by repo-relative POSIX path
parse_skill returns SkillRecord{name,description,metadata,body,own_refs,source_path}; name != directory name raises MissingNameError
parse_agent populates claude_keys per-file in source order (effort only on the researcher; memory/skills only on the verifier)
Unbalanced/missing/non-mapping/invalid-YAML frontmatter raises MalformedFrontmatterError("<src>: ..."); missing/non-string name raises MissingNameError; unreadable file raises UnreadableFileError
read_canon_text normalizes CRLF/CR to \n

bash scripts/validate.sh passes
items.notes: Parse is the ONLY place canon is read from disk; emitters consume records. Verify claude_keys against the real agents/*.md on branch forge/skill-spec-purity (00 §2 ground-truth table). A focused scratch/pytest check confirms behavior; the formal committed suite lands in item 007.

items.title: Implement shared emitter helpers + Claude and Cursor emitters
items.description:
Extend scripts/build-adapters.py with the cross-cutting emitter helpers (spec 03 §2) and the two CONFIRMED-format emitters: Claude (03 §3) and Cursor (03 §6). Implement exactly as specified.

1. Shared helpers (03 §2.1-§2.3): render_frontmatter_block(fields, source_path) serializing via yaml.safe_dump with sort_keys=False, default_flow_style=False, allow_unicode=True, width=4096, emitting the Form A provenance comment (PROVENANCE_FM_COMMENT) as the first line INSIDE the `---` block (`---` stays byte 0); order_fields(native) projecting onto FRONTMATTER_KEY_ORDER and asserting no key outside it; hint_value(skill) returning the metadata.argument-hint scalar or None; drop_all_claude_keys(agent, agent_id, reason) yielding one DropRecord per claude_keys entry in source order.
2. ClaudeEmitter (agent_id "claude", 03 §3): emit_skill emits skills/<name>/SKILL.md with {name, description, argument-hint?} where argument-hint is RECONSTRUCTED from metadata.argument-hint (REQ-VND-01) and omitted (no drop) when absent (forge-init analog); emit_agent emits agents/<name>.md with {name, description, **claude_keys} and ZERO drops (all keys representable).
3. CursorEmitter (agent_id "cursor", 03 §6): emit_skill emits skills/<name>/<name>.mdc with description/globs:[]/alwaysApply:false ONLY (no name field; identity via filename), argument-hint drop-recorded (reason "no Cursor .mdc invocation-hint field"); emit_agent emits a body-only .mdc and drop-records every claude_keys entry (reason "no Cursor sub-agent equivalent").
acceptanceCriteria: render_frontmatter_block output starts with `---` then `# GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT. Source: <src>. Regenerate: python3 scripts/build-adapters.py`; order_fields asserts the field set is a subset of FRONTMATTER_KEY_ORDER
ClaudeEmitter.emit_skill: a hinted skill yields top-level argument-hint; a hintless (forge-init analog) skill yields none with no DropRecord; relpath is skills/<name>/SKILL.md
ClaudeEmitter.emit_agent emits full {name,description,**claude_keys} frontmatter (per-file keys) with drops == ()
CursorEmitter.emit_skill yields skills/<name>/<name>.mdc with description/globs/alwaysApply only and an argument-hint DropRecord; emit_agent drop-records every claude_keys entry

bash scripts/validate.sh passes
items.notes: Claude and Cursor formats are CONFIRMED (not TQ-1): Claude is a round-trip of repo canon's pre-purity shape; Cursor .mdc keys are the documented Project-Rules schema. Emitters are pure (no clock/env/RNG/FS). description is preserved byte-for-byte via the shared dumper (REQ-FMT-04).

items.title: Implement Codex, Copilot and Gemini emitters (TQ-1 targets)
items.description:

CodexEmitter (agent_id "codex", 03 §4): emit_skill -> skills/<name>/<name>.md with {name, description} frontmatter + body; argument-hint drop-recorded. emit_agent -> a body artifact agents/<name>.md AND one ManifestEntry per sub-agent in EmitResult.manifest_entries (the aggregate agents/openai.yaml is written by the ENGINE later, not here); drop-record every claude_keys entry NOT in _CODEX_AGENT_KEYS (an empty frozenset until TQ-1 confirms the schema).

items.title: Implement provenance, self-containment pass, manifest serialization and generation report
items.description:
Extend scripts/build-adapters.py with the agent-independent passes the engine runs around the emitters, per spec 04. Implement exactly as written.

Self-containment pass (04 §2): run_self_containment_pass(bundle_root, repo_root, skills) adds (a) the WHOLE repo-root references/ tree verbatim, (b) each skill's own references/ subdir where own_refs is not None, (c) a byte-identical scripts/forge-root.sh copy (mode 0755, NO header). Generation report (04 §3): render_generation_report(drops) returns the report text — Form B body-top HTML provenance line first, `# Adapter Generation Report` heading, per-agent sections in AGENT_TARGETS order, rows sorted by (agent, source, construct), the "_No dropped constructs_" sentinel for empty sections (claude), and the fixed _render_verbatim_copies_section() at the end.

items.title: Implement engine orchestration: registry, build_tree, atomic publish, --check and main()
items.description:
Extend scripts/build-adapters.py with the orchestration core from spec 02 §2/§4/§5, wiring the emitters and the item-005 passes into a generator that runs end-to-end.

1. Registry (02 §2): AGENT_TARGETS_REGISTRY mapping each AGENT_TARGETS id to its emitter class; build_emitters() asserting registry keys == AGENT_TARGETS and instantiating in AGENT_TARGETS order.
2. Path sandbox (02 §4.2): _assert_within(path, allowed_root) and safe_write(allowed_root, relpath, content, mode) writing with newline="" (no CRLF translation) after asserting containment.
3. Atomic publish + pipeline (02 §4.1/§4.3): _new_staging_dir(root) -> adapters.tmp-<pid>/; _publish_emit_result writing EmitResult.files via safe_write; build_tree(root, dest) running discover->parse->per-agent emit loop, accumulating ManifestEntry-s per agent and calling _publish_manifest after that agent's loop, calling run_self_containment_pass per bundle, collecting all DropRecords and writing adapters/GENERATION-REPORT.md via render_generation_report; generate(root) building to the temp dir then os.replace-swapping over adapters/ (CanonError -> remove staging, print to stderr, return 1, NO partial tree); check(root) building to temp, diff -r vs committed adapters/, printing REMEDIATION_MESSAGE on drift (exit 1), exit 2 if diff is missing/errors, removing the temp dir in finally, never mutating adapters/.
4. main(argv) (02 §5): argparse with --check and --root (default = parent of script dir), dispatching to generate/check.

items.title: Author the hand-written canonical AGENTS.md
items.description:
Create AGENTS.md at the feature-forge repo root, hand-authored per the BINDING content checklist in spec 05 §3.3. It is NOT generated.

2. Repository conventions (four): spec-pure canon (skills/, agents/, references/ are the single source of truth; per-agent output is GENERATED into adapters/ and never hand-edited); stdlib + pinned-YAML tooling (Python 3 stdlib + Bash plus the single pinned YAML dep in scripts/requirements-adapters.txt, auto-provisioned into the gitignored .venv-adapters by validate.sh; no pnpm/TypeScript gate); the resolver/prelude pattern (scripts/forge-root.sh copied byte-identical into each bundle; canonical bootstrap prelude byte-identical everywhere); generated-output provenance (every file under adapters/ carries a GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT header naming its canonical source + the regenerate command).
3. Install-path priority: Claude Code marketplace/plugin install is preferred/first-class (C-5), then the universal cross-agent install path (owned by cross-agent-installer; name it as the fallback, do not document its mechanics).
4. The dependency-upgrade trade-off (D2): a YAML-dependency version bump is a behavior change requiring regenerating adapters/, reviewing the diff, and committing it (the drift guard fails the gate otherwise).

items.title: Wire validate.sh step 6b drift guard + venv provisioning (completion gate)
items.description:
Add the regenerate-and-diff drift guard to scripts/validate.sh as a new top-level step, per spec 05 §2 — the feature's completion gate.

Insert the "6b.
